messianic_thread.ot_text: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
messianic_thread.nt_text: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

messianic_thread.ot_text: The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
messianic_thread.nt_text: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

messianic_thread.ot_text: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
messianic_thread.nt_text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

messianic_thread.ot_text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
messianic_thread.nt_text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

messianic_thread.ot_text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but…
messianic_thread.nt_text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
messianic_thread.nt_text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
messianic_thread.nt_text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

messianic_thread.ot_text: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

messianic_thread.ot_text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
messianic_thread.nt_text: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

messianic_thread.ot_text: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art …
messianic_thread.nt_text: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

messianic_thread.ot_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
messianic_thread.nt_text: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent…
messianic_thread.nt_text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

messianic_thread.ot_text: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

messianic_thread.ot_text: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:

messianic_thread.ot_text: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

messianic_thread.ot_text: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
messianic_thread.nt_text: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

messianic_thread.ot_text: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eye…

messianic_thread.ot_text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

messianic_thread.ot_text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
messianic_thread.nt_text: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my ve…

messianic_thread.ot_text: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

messianic_thread.ot_text: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
messianic_thread.nt_text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

messianic_thread.ot_text: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little on…
messianic_thread.nt_text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

messianic_thread.ot_text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
messianic_thread.nt_text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

messianic_thread.ot_text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an…
messianic_thread.nt_text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

messianic_thread.ot_text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an…
messianic_thread.nt_text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
messianic_thread.nt_text: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

messianic_thread.ot_text: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
messianic_thread.nt_text: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

messianic_thread.ot_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

messianic_thread.ot_text: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?
messianic_thread.nt_text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

messianic_thread.ot_text: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
messianic_thread.nt_text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

messianic_thread.ot_text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
messianic_thread.nt_text: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

messianic_thread.ot_text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
messianic_thread.nt_text: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

messianic_thread.ot_text: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
messianic_thread.nt_text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

messianic_thread.ot_text: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

messianic_thread.ot_text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
messianic_thread.nt_text: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

messianic_thread.ot_text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will sh…
messianic_thread.nt_text: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

messianic_thread.ot_text: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
messianic_thread.nt_text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

messianic_thread.ot_text: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
messianic_thread.nt_text: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

messianic_thread.ot_text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
messianic_thread.nt_text: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

messianic_thread.ot_text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
messianic_thread.nt_text: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

messianic_thread.ot_text: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
messianic_thread.nt_text: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
